षट्क: ṣaṭka, 	—1. a. consisting of six; 	—2. as n. a whole consisting of six, a hexade. [ṣaṣ, 1222a, 226b.]
षट्पद: ṣáṭ-pada, f. -ī, a. having (taken) six steps. [ṣaṣ: 1300a.]
षण्मास: ṣaṇ-māsa, n. semester, six months. [ṣaṣ: prop. ‘that which has six months,’ see 1312.]
षष्: ṣáṣ [4833], num. six. [see 182b2, 1463: cf. ἕξ, Lat. sex, Eng. six.]
षष्ठ: ṣaṣṭhá, a. sixth. [ṣaṣ, 4875: cf. ἕκ-τος, Lat. sex-tus, AS. six-ta, Eng. six-th.]
